WEBSITE.FAILED_BODY: Check that the address is right and the site is public, then try again.

TEST.TITLE: Test your AI agent
TEST.DESCRIPTION: Ask what your customers would ask. Nothing you type here reaches a customer.

LIVE.TITLE: Turn your AI agent on
LIVE.DESCRIPTION: It answers visitors in your website chat. Your team can take over any conversation.
LIVE.KNOWLEDGE_IMPORTING: Pages are still being read. It answers from the ready ones.
LIVE.NO_KNOWLEDGE: No knowledge yet. Add your website first.
LIVE.INBOX_NEW: A website chat will be created

INSTALL.TITLE: Add the chat to your website
INSTALL.DESCRIPTION: Paste this code before the closing body tag on every page, or into your site builder's custom code setting.
INSTALL.NO_INBOX: Turn the AI agent on first. That creates your website chat.

RESULT.INSTALLED: The chat runs on your website.
RESULT.SCRIPT_FOUND: Found the code on {site}. It shows as installed after the first visit.
RESULT.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find the code on {site}. If you add it with a tag manager, open your site once and check again.
RESULT.UNREACHABLE: We couldn't open {site}. Check that it is public.
RESULT.ERROR: The check didn't finish. Try again.
